post.summary: Issue an embedded editor session
post.description:
Authorize one staff member to prepare one document (or upload one) inside the embedded editor. Call it from your backend after authorizing your own user and record.

- mode (required): existing (reopen a draft you uploaded) or upload (staff upload inside the editor).

- envelopeId: required for existing, forbidden for upload.

- parentOrigin (required): the exact HTTPS origin of the page that will host the iframe. It must be registered on this API key first; loopback HTTP is accepted for local testing only.

- externalActorId (required): your own opaque id for the staff member, 1–200 characters. Recorded in the audit trail.

- actions (required): [edit] or [edit, send]. Editing is always required.

- externalId and metadata (upload mode only, optional): recorded on the draft the upload creates and echoed in every webhook.

- Idempotency-Key (optional): a retry after a lost response returns a fresh launchToken for the same session, and the earlier token stops working.
post.x-rate-limit: 30 per 60s per workspace and API key

delete.description:
End a session immediately, for example when your staff member signs out. Only the API key that issued the session can revoke it.

- id: the sessionId returned when the session was issued. No request body.
delete.x-rate-limit: 30 per 60s per workspace and API key

post.summary: Upload inside the editor (editor only)
post.description:
Called by the editor when staff choose a PDF in an upload-mode session. One session creates at most one draft; a retry returns that draft.

- Multipart file (required), with the same limits as the upload operation.

Create a draft from one PDF. Save the returned id and draftRevision for the next steps.

- Multipart file (required): PDF, up to 25 MiB and 500 pages; encrypted PDFs are rejected.

- title (optional): 1–200 characters; defaults to the filename without its extension.

- documentCategory (optional): defaults to OTHER. jurisdictionCode (optional): overrides the workspace default. Policy is fixed at creation.

- externalId (optional): your own id for this document, 1–200 characters of letters, digits and _ . : @ -. Not unique. Echoed in every webhook and used to filter the list.

- metadata (optional): a JSON object as text, up to 10 string values and 2 KB in total. Echoed in every webhook.

- Idempotency-Key (optional): 8–128 letters, digits, dots, dashes or colons. Repeating the same key and body within 24 hours returns the envelope the first request created (Idempotency-Replayed: true) instead of a second draft. Without a key, every request creates a new draft.

- fields: up to 1,000 entries. Each needs a new client-generated UUID id, recipientId, type and pageNumber (starting at 1). Keep the same field id on later saves.

post.summary: Send for signing
post.description:
Validate the draft and queue invitations. Signing happens on Envelope through emailed links.

- Optional JSON: expiresInDays (1–90), message (up to 2,000 characters or null), reminderIntervalDays (1–30 or null to disable). Omitted timing values use server defaults.

- Idempotency-Key (required): 8–128 letters, digits, dots, dashes or colons; a UUID is ideal. Reuse the same key and body on a network retry within 24 hours. A replay includes Idempotency-Replayed: true.

- Sending is asynchronous: a successful response does not mean mail has arrived or signing is complete. Wait for envelope.completed before downloading the sealed version.

200.description: Recipients reminded now, and those skipped with the reason for each.

post.summary: Send a reminder
post.description:
Email a fresh signing link to the people whose turn it is and who have not finished. The previous link stops working.

- Optional JSON: recipientIds, a list of recipient UUIDs. Omitted, it reminds everyone whose turn it is.

- One reminder per person per 24 hours: anyone reminded sooner comes back in skipped with a reason, and if nobody could be reminded the request answers 429 REMINDER_TOO_SOON with Retry-After. A full-access key only; shares the 30 a minute workspace limit with cancel.

- JSON reason (1–1,000 characters): required for a sent envelope, optional for a draft. It is emailed to recipients and is not stored in the audit trail.

- A full-access key only. Fires envelope.voided. Limited to 30 requests a minute per workspace, shared with reminders and deadline changes.

info.title: Envelope powered by HealthProHub API
info.description:
Server-to-server API for creating, sending and tracking documents for signature.

- **Base URL:** `/api/v1` on your Envelope host.
- **Authentication:** `Authorization: Bearer <API key>` (scheme `apiKey`). A key can call only the operations listed here; every other route needs a signed-in session.
- **Errors:** RFC 7807 `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`.
- **Webhooks:** see the `x-webhooks` extension and the `Webhook*` schemas.
- **Guide:** `docs/developers/` in the repository is the same contract as a readable guide.

tags.name: Envelopes
tags.description: Create, list and read documents sent for signing.

tags.name: Drafts
tags.description: Edit a draft before it is sent. Every edit needs `If-Match` with the latest draftRevision.

tags.name: Documents
tags.description: Download the original, the sealed or the certificate PDF.

tags.name: Embedded editor
tags.description: Issue and revoke embedded sender-editor sessions. The editor itself calls the rest.

apiKey.description: A server API key, created in Settings → Integrations. Keep it on your server.

session.description: A signed-in person’s session token (the web app).

embedSession.description: The token an embedded editor session receives after its launch handshake.

errors.description: Per-field problems, on VALIDATION_FAILED and NOT_READY_TO_SEND.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor`; null on the last page.

draftRevision.description: Send back as If-Match on the next draft edit.

WebhookEvent.description: The JSON body of every webhook delivery. `data` always carries `externalId` and `metadata` (null when unset) alongside the fields listed for the event.

id.description: The event id, stable across retries. Deduplicate on it.

WebhookEventEnvelopeSent.description: The envelope was sent and invitations were queued; this does not confirm inbox delivery.

WebhookEventEnvelopeViewed.description: A recipient opened their link for the first time.

WebhookEventRecipientConsented.description: A recipient accepted electronic signing consent.

WebhookEventRecipientSigned.description: A recipient finished; the sealing worker may still be running.

WebhookEventRecipientDeclined.description: A recipient declined and the envelope closed.

WebhookEventEnvelopeCompleted.description: The final PDF is sealed. Use finalVersionNumber to download it.

WebhookEventEnvelopeVoided.description: The sender cancelled the envelope or discarded its draft.

WebhookEventEnvelopeExpired.description: The deadline passed with unfinished recipients. Signing is paused.

WebhookEventEnvelopeExtended.description: The sender gave an expired envelope a new deadline, reopening it.

x-webhooks.description: Signed POST requests sent to your registered endpoint. Verify `X-Signature` over "<X-Signature-Timestamp>.<raw body>" with HMAC-SHA256.

headers.name: X-Signature
headers.description: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<timestamp>.<raw body>">. During a secret rotation it lists one signature per accepted secret, comma-separated.

headers.name: X-Signature-Timestamp
headers.description: Unix seconds when this attempt was signed. Reject anything older than five minutes.

headers.name: X-Envelope-Event-Id
headers.description: The event id, the same on every retry and redrive. Deduplicate on this.

headers.name: X-Envelope-Event-Type
headers.description: The event type, so you can route before parsing the body.

headers.name: X-Envelope-Delivery-Id
headers.description: Identifies this delivery record; it is what the Deliveries screen shows.

headers.name: X-Envelope-Delivery-Attempt
headers.description: The attempt number, starting at 1 and continuing across manual redrives.
